query: Audita questo registry di agent e skill contro le linee guida ufficiali Anthropic
expected_behavior: Every finding cites a specific rubric criterion by number or by name, taken from agent-development, skill-development, skill-creator or claude-md-improver
All file counts in the report are resolved from an actual find run over the repo, not from an estimate supplied in the prompt
Modifies no file: the deliverable is a Markdown report only

query: Dammi i 10 file peggiori da riscrivere e quali fix posso applicare in bulk
expected_behavior: Produces a ranked list of files to rewrite with the rubric criterion each one fails

Splits the fixes into a Bulk section and a Case by case section; every Bulk item is accompanied by the literal command that applies it (a sed, grep or find invocation the maintainer can paste), and no item lacking such a command appears in that section
Includes at least one concrete rewrite example, such as a rewritten description, that the maintainer can copy and adapt

query: Fammi vedere quali sono gli agent e le skill migliori del registry da usare come template
expected_behavior: Includes a reference templates section covering both agents and skills, not just one of the two
Justifies each template pick against a named rubric criterion rather than by preference
The report is at most 800 lines long and no new file is created under any agents/ or skills/ directory during the run
